svg.title: 11 Background execution detail with DataContract
svg.text: Background execution detail · accept, dispatch, calculate and report the outcome
Shared mechanism for Core and custom runs. This detail uses the custom Regional example: Silver 800 + override 700. Start with the lifecycle on page 9.
ACCEPTANCE · read the published Data Contract and save the exact calculation instructions
Check request replay and the saved scenario revision
New request; saved regional input is 700
Python validates the edit and contract hash,
then freezes input, function versions and plan.
Commit input 700 + contract version 1 + frozen plan + Waiting + receipt +
par [background processing and client status checks run independently]
Claim ownership; open attempt; mark Calculating; load frozen input and plan
Input 700 + original contract version 1 + exact function release
Commit Gold { DeathPenatly: 630 } + contract lineage + audit + Ready together
else [calculation fails: retry handling is expanded on page 12]
Roll back incomplete output; save failure reason and retry eligibility
[CLIENT STATUS CHECKS] Repeat while Waiting, Calculating or Retrying; stop at Ready or Failed.
Read current status, result reference and retry eligibility
Waiting / Calculating / Retrying OR Ready + result reference OR Failed +
The Data Contract is read at acceptance. Workers and retries use the saved plan. All three Snowflake participants are logical roles in the same database. Proposed design.
